title: Targeted therapy with anakinra for dilated cardiomyopathy: phase IIa randomized double blind monocentric clinical trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of anakinra plus standard of care vs standard of care alone in the treatment of dilated cardiomyopathy.
official: Deciphering IL-1 mediated inflammation for the targeted treatment of dilated cardiomyopathy.
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of IL-1 therapeutic blockade with Anakinra in improving Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction (LVEF) assessed by Trans Thoracic Echocardiograhy (TTE) at 4 weeks.
